Hiring guidance

What to look for.

01

Trade experience

Ask which services they modelled: HVAC, electrical, plumbing or fire-fighting, and to what LOD.

02

Coordination order

Strong MEP modelers fix gravity drainage first and route pressurised services around it.

03

Shop drawings

Check they have produced installation-ready shop and builder's work drawings.
